name: 69361 · Scottsbluff, NE
findings: ZIP 69361 (Scottsbluff) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 69361 (Scottsbluff) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 69361 (Scottsbluff) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
